item.tib: gcod gdams kyi bskongs ba don 'dus
item.coloph: bskang (skong) bshags gtsang ma'i don 'dus zhes bya ba/ kun tu bzang pos 'chi med gsang ba 'dus pa la gdams(te)/ gsang ba 'dus pas klu grub la gdams/ klu grub ye shes kyi snying po la gdams/ stong rgyung mthu chen (gyis) zhang zhung gi gshen po drung mu ha ra la gdams nas yi ger bkod pa rdzogs so//
